text: That afternoon: Holmes sketches out for Miss Stoner what occurred in the morning, and she turns white
why: ¶125-127 place this in the afternoon: Holmes greets her with 'Good-afternoon', sketches what occurred with Roylott that morning, and she turns white to the lips.
¶127 states Holmes sketched out in a few words what had occurred, referring to the morning's encounter with the Doctor.
